title: Integrating Uncertainty Quantification into Robust Multi-Agent Equilibrium Learning

contributions.purpose: 提出把认知不确定性纳入均衡稳定性的新解概念ε-RNE
contributions.mechanism: 用CVaR相干风险度量替代期望收益,定义风险可利用度∆ρ并给出收敛证明(ε→0恢复经典NE)
contributions.evaluation: 理论:证明NashConvρ≤ε即认证ε-RNE(Lemma 1),风险中性极限退化为经典Nash
contributions.domain: 多智能体强化学习/博弈均衡
contributions.source_quote: (1) The ε-Robust Nash Equilibrium incorporating epistemic uncertainty into stability analysis

contributions.purpose: 给出带收敛保证的去中心化学习算法
contributions.mechanism: 深度集成UQ + CVaR保守价值目标 + 不确定性引导探索 + KL信赖域 + 风险感知NashConv停止准则
contributions.evaluation: 训练中NashConvρ系统性下降至≤ε容差(各任务0.03-0.05),称首个ε-RNE收敛经验证据
contributions.source_quote: (2) A decentralized learning algorithm with convergence guarantees

contributions.purpose: 跨四类多智能体环境实证鲁棒性提升
contributions.mechanism: 在协作/竞争/混合任务下对比risk-neutral、DistRL、worst-case基线
contributions.evaluation: 分布漂移下CVaR提升13-19%,灾难失败率降40-45%,均值性能不变
contributions.source_quote: we achieve 13–19% CVaR improvements and 40–45% reductions in catastrophic failures under distribution shift while maintaining average performance

self_declared_provenance.quote: We apply CVaR end-to-end—both in value targets and in equilibrium evaluation—so tail safety is an explicit objective rather than an emergent byproduct
